bio_text: Prabhdeep Singh is a first-year Computer Science student at the University of Toronto focused on AI research. He explores how machine learning models store and retrieve concepts, why certain prompts trigger specific behaviors, and what happens when systems are pushed to their limits. Self-taught through online resources, he builds things before fully understanding theory, then goes back to clean up the mathematical foundations.
